about: Playgrounds once listed from OpenStreetMap alone that the OpenStreetMap snapshot puts inside school grounds, removed on 23 November 2026 because school playgrounds usually aren't open to everyone. Keyed by OpenStreetMap id. They aren't added again from OpenStreetMap alone, but any official source brings one back: the coverage check adds those on council lists it reads, the quarterly check reports those on any council list, and scripts/school-grounds.mjs (run by the coverage check) clears the entry of every one that has a listing with an official source. Two parents saying it's open to everyone also brings one back: its old address asks them (worker/school-grounds.js), and the daily "Move pins parents agree on" workflow puts back those they agree on. The old page addresses are kept in "page".
